'''2013 Match Play Championship Day 1 Brian Brodsky LS You Can Either Profit By This...''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Brian Brodsky]] at [[2013 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed]]
* '''Username:''' bbrodsky50
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
